rule.expression: (http.host eq "api.satelink.network" or http.host eq "rpc.satelink.network") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/")

restore_note: To restore verbatim: PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/{ruleset_id}/rules/{rule[id]} with body = this rule object (drop id/last_updated/version/ref keys, keep action/description/enabled/expression/ratelimit).
